[b]Overhaul.[/b]

[i]Plans to overhaul the Dushkari electrical grid has begun thanks to a request by the parliament. The military on the hand opposes this, but to not interfere with democracy, has decided to do nothing. Currently all of Dushkaria is powered by four nuclear power plants, with the majority of power being provided by the Hysperia Alphia Maxhima nuclear reactor cluster situated at the outskirts of Eyosius. While nuclear power has been serving Dushkaria for decades, the need for something renewable and less volatile is probably a good idea.[/i]

[i]Not only that, it could modernize the ageing reactors, and alleviate the costs of running such a massive power plant.[/i]
